Model reduction plan for this training model:

1. FactSales has no unused columns — every column is either a key, a measure input, or the row-context demo column used in Lab 02.

2. High-cardinality risk: DimCustomer[CustomerName] and FactOrders[CustomerName] are text columns with one distinct value per customer. Prefer a surrogate CustomerKey for relationships (already used on FactSales) and keep the name column only where it must be displayed.

3. Date/time precision: DimOrderDate[Date] stores only the Date component (no time), which keeps cardinality to one row per calendar day instead of one row per timestamp. FactSales[OrderDate]/[ShipDate] are also typed as Date, not DateTime, for the same reason.

4. FactOrders (Lab 03 Power Query source) intentionally keeps CustomerName and SalesChannel as text for a raw-ingestion exercise — in a production model these would be replaced by key columns to a dimension.

5. Numeric precision: Quantity and UnitPrice/UnitCost are stored as whole-number int64 types rather than decimal, avoiding the higher storage cost of high-precision fixed decimal columns where cents-level precision isn't required by this dataset.

Recommended removals/changes if this were a production model: drop any column not used by a measure, a relationship, or a visual; convert free-text description columns to key-based dimensions; round decimal columns to the precision actually needed by the business.
